as_told.title: Travis Walton case with beings working together

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, on a podcast, retells the story of Travis Walton, a man who says he was taken aboard a strange craft in Arizona in 1975. Jorjani says Walton was first with greys, the small grey beings common in such accounts, then wandered down a hallway, ran into tall human-looking beings often called Nordics, and was handled by them from then on. In Walton's own words, played on the same show, he simply says a human-looking man came in while he was looking for a way out, with no mention of a handover; the story matters to those who tell it because it would suggest different kinds of beings working together.
